name: Zen Drift Cruise
summary: Chill drifting at golden sunset or starry night with rain, km odometer counter, mountain pines, and lofi beats.
description: Experience a relaxing endless asphalt drift cruise on your Mac surrounded entirely by a lush mountain pine forest. Track your distance with a real-time kilometer (km) odometer. Choose whether it's a golden sunset or clear night, and whether it rains or not: drift through slick wet asphalt in sunset rain or cruise dry asphalt under warm twilight. Toggle sunset with 'P' and rain with 'T'. Features generative lo-fi chords, off-road mud drag slowdown, and 'R' key instant respawn.

tools.name: launch_cruise
tools.title: Launch Cruise
tools.description: Launch the chill drift cruise game in a dedicated Mac window with live odometer distance counter in km, choice of golden sunset or clear starry night, combined with rain or dry asphalt. Features pine forests all around the road, winding curves, roadside trees, lofi music, mud slowdown drag, P-key sunset toggle, and R-key restart. Use when the user asks to drive, drift at sunset, drift in the rain, chill out in the forest, or play the drift game.

sunset.description: Whether to cruise at golden sunset (true) or deep night (false). Defaults to true for sunset

rain.description: Whether to have rain (true for wet rain drift, false for clear dry asphalt. Defaults to true)

weather.description: Weather condition preset (e.g. 'Golden Sunset Rain', 'Golden Sunset Clear', 'Night Rain', 'Clear Starry Night')

forest.description: Forest style all around the road (e.g. 'Dense Touge Pines All Around Road', 'Lush Mountain Pines')

soundtrack.description: Soundtrack mode (e.g. 'Chill Lo-fi Beat Loop (48kHz)', 'Ambient Night Engine')

curves.description: Road curvature preset (e.g. 'Frequent Winding Curves', 'Tight Mountain Touge')

mud_effect.description: Off-road mud physics effect (e.g. 'Heavy Mud Drag (-70% Speed Drag)', 'Deep Mud Slurry')

tools.name: get_cruise_status
tools.title: Cruise Status
tools.description: Check whether the drift cruise session is active, viewing distance traveled in kilometers (km), sunset state (golden sunset vs night), rain condition (rain vs clear dry asphalt), surface condition (asphalt vs off-road mud drag), forest density, speed, cruise duration, and lofi audio. Use when the user asks for drift status, distance in km, cruise time, sunset state, weather, surface conditions, or speed.

tools.name: toggle_rain
tools.title: Toggle Rain
tools.description: Turn rain on or off during the drift cruise, switching between wet asphalt rain and clear dry asphalt while preserving the sunset or night horizon. Use when the user asks to turn off rain, turn on rain, stop raining, make it rain, or toggle rain at sunset or night.

enable_rain.description: Set true for rain ON (wet asphalt), false for rain OFF (dry asphalt). If omitted, toggles state.

intensity.description: Rain intensity percentage from 0 to 100 when enabling rain (default 85)

root.html:
WEATHER CONTROL
Toggle Rain
KEY: [T]
Switch between wet asphalt rain and clear dry asphalt skies at sunset or night.
Press [T] in game to toggle instantly

tools.name: toggle_sunset
tools.title: Toggle Sunset
tools.description: Switch between a warm Golden Sunset and Deep Night ambiance, pairing seamlessly with either rain or dry roads. Use when the user asks to turn on sunset, turn off sunset, switch to sunset, switch to night, or toggle sunset time of day.

enable_sunset.description: Set true for Golden Sunset sky, false for Deep Night. If omitted, toggles between sunset and night.

root.html:
TIME OF DAY
Toggle Sunset
KEY: [P]
Switch between Golden Sunset horizon and Deep Night skies, with or without rain.
Press [P] in game to toggle instantly

tools.name: set_ambiance
tools.title: Set Ambiance
tools.description: Adjust sunset state, rain state, rain intensity, road wetness reflections, curve frequency, forest style, mud drag, and lofi soundtrack during the drift cruise. Use when the user wants to set sunset, rain, weather preset, or music.

sunset.description: Choose time of day: true for golden sunset, false for deep night

rain.description: Choose whether rain is active: true for wet asphalt rain, false for clear dry road

weather_preset.description: Proposed weather ambiance preset (e.g. 'Golden Sunset Rain & Wet Asphalt', 'Golden Sunset • Dry Asphalt', 'Night Rain', 'Clear Starry Night')

rain_density.description: Rain density percentage from 0 to 100 (0 turns rain off)

forest_style.description: Forest style all around the road (e.g. 'Dense Touge Pines All Around Road', 'Lush Mountain Pines')

curve_style.description: Curve frequency style (e.g. 'Frequent Winding Curves', 'Tight Mountain Touge', 'Gentle Sweeps')

mud_drag.description: Off-road mud resistance style (e.g. 'Heavy Mud Drag (-70% Speed Drag)', 'Deep Mud Slurry')

tools.name: restart_cruise
tools.title: Restart Cruise
tools.description: Respawn the drift car at the starting line, reset speed to zero, reset distance counter to 0.00 km, clear skid and mud tracks, and restart the cruise timer in the pine forest. Use when the user asks to restart the car, reset distance, reset the cruise, start over, or respawn with 'R'.

reason.description: Optional note or reason for restarting (e.g. 'Stuck in deep mud', 'Fresh sunset run')

root.html:
